caption: The drawing depicts an oval object, resembling a shield, with a thick, solid golden-brown border surrounding the entire shape. The interior background is dark gray or black and is decorated with a symmetrical pattern of stylized motifs. There are four wide, radiating yellow lines made out of linked circular dots that start from a central point and curve outward toward the edge, forming an X-like structure. Between these yellow dotted lines are golden star shapes and symmetric cross motifs, alternating in size and orientation. The space in between the patterns is filled with tessellated, light gray, floral or star-shaped motifs arranged in a grid-like formation. At the bottom right corner of the drawing, outside the oval, there is a small, faintly sketched oval diagram divided by curved intersecting lines. The overall composition is symmetrical, with a clear division of space and repetition of the decorative motifs.
title: Oval Pin
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
